data.long_meaning: In Old English, Prentice originated from the name Preht, which means 'priest'. The suffix '-ice' denotes 'son'. This name thus signifies 'Son of the Priest'. The name Prentice carries the meaning “Son of the priest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Prentice usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the priest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prentice total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
